lemma iteration_copy_location (N : RootedBinary V E X) {sample : Copy → X}
    (r : PositivePairRates E) (n : ℕ) (s d : Code N sample)
    (hd : d ∈ (sourceIteration N r n s).support) (x : Copy) :
    copyLocation (state d) x = copyLocation (state s) x := by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero =>
    have h : d = s := by simpa [sourceIteration] using hd
    subst d
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨m,hm,hdm⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_bind_iff _ _ _).mp hd
    obtain ⟨p,_,hp⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hm
    subst m
    exact (ih _ hdm).trans (destination_copy_location N s p x)

    copyLocation (state s) x = originalPlace N (codePopulation N s x) := by
  unfold codePopulation
  cases h : copyLocation (state s) x with
  | node v => exact False.elim (hs x v h)
  | edge e => rfl
  | rootPopulation v =>
    have hv := s.property.original_descendant x
    change DescendsTo N (copyLocation (state s) x) (sample x) at hv
    rw [h] at hv
    exact congrArg Location.rootPopulation hv.1

            ((originalProgramLaw N sample p r past).toOuterMeasure

            (fun s => triplePopulationRate r (codePopulation N s.val ∘ i))
            (fun s => ancestorPartition (codePopulation N s.val ∘ i)) (u : ℝ) gene := by

    rw [gap_three_parts hleft hright u hu] at hw
    have ho := actual_observed_two_cut_partition_law N C sample H p common r P

    exact actual_activated_ratio_mixture N C sample H p common r
      (firstOriginalDate N C) dates elapsed u hsample i gene
